method.fit: Frozen M3 linear-head fit replayed from the exact cached training and selector features after the original attempt terminated
method.candidateOrder: five weight decays in frozen order, then five upstream blend alphas in frozen order
method.thresholdEnumeration: minimum serialized float32 selector logit plus binary64 nextafter(logit,+infinity) for every unique finite selector logit; comparisons are binary64 so every stored-logit partition is tested
